summary: This is a draft for counsel's review, computed from the record with machine-checked lines. Of 24 key details, investigators introduced 5 first in the transcripts (a knife, shot in the head, Avery raised the RAV4's hood, and two others), and the suspect adopted each after questions that named the detail. Nine details were already public before the interviews. Eight details appear first from the suspect in the available record (tied up with rope, restrained on the bed in Avery's bedroom, stabbed in the stomach, and five others), with no earlier transcript supplying them. Two details (bleach on his jeans, blood on the garage floor) may trace to earlier conversations that lack public transcripts. One detail (a tattoo on her stomach) was raised by investigators but never adopted.
key_points: Investigators first: A knife. Investigators first said it (Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. 460); the suspect first adopted it after that (Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. 460).

Investigators first: Shot in the head. Investigators first said it (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 587); the suspect first adopted it by agreeing to a question (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 587).

Investigators first: Avery raised the RAV4's hood. Investigators first said it (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 603); the suspect first adopted it by agreeing to a question (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 603).
From him first in the record: She was tied up with rope. The suspect said it first (Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. 471), and nothing earlier in the transcripts supplies it.

From him first in the record: Restrained on the bed in Avery's bedroom. The suspect said it first (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 566), and nothing earlier in the transcripts supplies it.
From him first in the record: Stabbed in the stomach. The suspect said it first (Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. 470), and nothing earlier in the transcripts supplies it.

Reported publicly before the interviews (9): Her body was in the back of the RAV4; Shot with a .22 rifle; Shot inside the garage; Her body was burned in the fire behind the garage; Tires and branches were put on the fire; The RAV4 was hidden in the salvage yard under branches and a car hood; The license plates were removed; The vehicle key was put in Avery's bedroom; Her clothes were burned.

May trace to an earlier conversation with no public transcript: Bleach on his jeans from cleaning the garage floor. An earlier statement with no public transcript is reported outside the transcripts (we can't read it): on the evening of Feb 27, 2006 he told Fassbender he got bleach on his pants helping clean Avery's garage floor (Decision and Order p. 7, citing ECF 19-19 at 10-11). In the transcripts it first appears at Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 527.

May trace to an earlier conversation with no public transcript: Blood on the garage floor. Investigators first said it (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 547), but in words that may refer to something he said earlier with no public transcript (p. 547: “I talked to ya the other night and you said nothing about Monte you said nothing about something getting punctured and leaking out.” … “We talked about cleaning somethin' up in that garage. You told me that you thought thinking back now there was blood.”).
Never adopted: A tattoo on her stomach. Investigators raised it (Mar 1, 2006, Manitowoc County Sheriff's Dept., p. 662), but the suspect never stated or agreed to it.
